# 03.02-ui Progress

- Retargeted `Mulse.Ui/Mulse.Ui.csproj` from `net10.0` to `net11.0`; its `Mulse.ServiceDefaults` reference now resolves to the `net11.0` target. The .NET 11 dependency graph resolves `Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets` 11.0.0 and the updated `Microsoft.Extensions.*` dependencies.
- Resolved the assessment's source-compatibility finding in `Components/Pages/ModulePackages.razor` by passing an explicit `Task[]` to `Task.WhenAll`, avoiding the .NET 11 overload ambiguity while preserving concurrent execution and aggregate exception behavior. No generated `obj` files were edited.
- Reviewed the 47 potential behavioral findings. They concern existing URI escaping, HTTP-content reads, exception handling, `NotSupportedException`, and `MemoryStream` call sites. The assessment does not identify a required replacement or changed expected result; the existing calls remain appropriate for their roles. No UI-specific tests were discovered in Test Explorer, so runtime behavioral coverage remains for final application validation.
- `dotnet build Mulse.Ui\Mulse.Ui.csproj` succeeded with 0 warnings and 0 errors; output assembly exists at `Mulse.Ui/bin/Debug/net11.0/Mulse.Ui.dll`. The `Mulse.ServiceDefaults` net11.0 reference assembly is also present.
- Visual Studio `run_build` reported NU1201 because the not-yet-retargeted `Service.Tests` project still targets `net10.0` while referencing the now-net11-only UI. This is the planned dependency boundary and will be resolved in subtask `03.03-tests`; the targeted CLI build of the UI succeeds. The IDE tool also reports the prior multi-target ServiceDefaults issue, so `dotnet build` is recorded as the validation tool for this project.
